proof:
have hS : S = ({-14, 8} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hp : (x + 14) * (x - 8) = 0 := by nlinarith [h]
      rcases _root_.mul_eq_zero.mp hp with h | h
      · left; linarith
      · right; linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num
